flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4313/#HelloThere then Do these steps in order.
Find the tiddler titled 'HelloThere' and click the edit button (pencil icon) at its top right. If the pencil is not visible, @v16:"click the small down arrow at the tiddler's top right and choose 'edit' in the menu."
Wait until the tiddler is in edit mode, with a large text box for its content.
Scroll the page if needed so that the row of formatting icons (bold, italic and others) directly above the large text box is near the top of the screen, with plenty of empty space below it.
Is this true right now: "The tiddler HelloThere is in edit mode, and a row of formatting icons such as bold and italic is visible directly above its large text box."? If it is true, @v16:"store the word yes as 'ready'." If it is not true, @v16:"store the word no as 'ready'."
In the row of formatting icons directly above the large text box, click the down arrow icon that opens more toolbar buttons. It is near the right end of the row, just to the left of the eye (preview) icon. Do not click the arrow to the right of the eye icon. A dropdown opens and must stay open; do not click anything else.
Wait 2 seconds.
Then stop.

hellothere_edit_mode.query: whether the HelloThere tiddler editor showing Draft of 'HelloThere' is present in the Editor region
hellothere_edit_mode.condition: The tiddler HelloThere is in edit mode.
hellothere_edit_mode.human_description: Checking whether HelloThere is in edit mode
hellothere_edit_mode.subject: the tiddler HelloThere in edit mode
hellothere_edit_mode.code_js: (() => { const editor = el(110); return editor.innerText.includes("Draft of 'HelloThere'") && !!editor.querySelector('textarea.tc-edit-texteditor-body') && !!editor.querySelector('button[title="Confirm changes to this tiddler"]'); })()

formatting_icons_visible.query: whether the Editor region contains a visible formatting toolbar with bold and italic controls directly before the visible large text editor
formatting_icons_visible.condition: A row of formatting icons such as bold and italic is visible directly above its large text box.
formatting_icons_visible.human_description: Checking whether the formatting icon row is visible above the text box
formatting_icons_visible.subject: a row of formatting icons such as bold and italic directly above its large text box
formatting_icons_visible.code_js: (() => { const editor = el(110); const toolbar = editor.querySelector('.tc-editor-toolbar'); const box = editor.querySelector('iframe.tc-edit-texteditor-body'); const bold = toolbar && toolbar.querySelector('button[title*="ctrl-B"]'); const italic = toolbar && toolbar.querySelector('button[title*="ctrl-I"]'); return !!(toolbar && box && bold && italic && toolbar.getClientRects().length && box.getClientRects().length && toolbar.compareDocumentPosition(box) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING); })()
